description: The market at a glance, no key: the S&P 500, Nasdaq, Dow, Russell 2000 and VIX, the eleven S&P sectors (SPDR funds) ranked by the month, Treasury yields from 13 weeks to 30 years, the dollar and major currencies, oil, gas, gold, silver and copper, bitcoin and ether, and the main markets in Europe and Asia, each with its last close and its change over a day, a week, a month, three months, the year to date and a year.

groups.description: Which groups to show (us, sectors, rates, currencies, commodities, crypto, world); default all.
